Top 10 Executive Insights & Management Directives

Data-Backed Evidence
🔴

1. Customer Sentiment Crisis — Mean Rating 2.97 / 5.0

Evidence: 1,879 orders (37.6%) rated 1-2 stars. Only 37.9% rated Good (4-5).
Business Risk: Churn velocity and negative brand equity across global markets.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Not driven by lead time (p=0.21). Product quality expectations or UI checkout friction.
Action Directive: Trigger automated CSAT feedback workflows for orders rated ≤ 2 stars with target of 3.6/5.0.
🟡

2. Major Latent Revenue: 96% Customer Dormancy

Evidence: Only 989 of 25,000 registered users have ever placed an order (3.96% activation).
Opportunity: Activating just 10% of dormant accounts yields ~$2.5M in incremental GMV.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Onboarding dropout and lack of welcome discount incentives.
Action Directive: Deploy a 3-stage automated reactivation drip campaign with limited-time first-order incentives.
🔴

3. Operational Fulfillment Friction: 37.7% Slow Shipments

Evidence: 1,883 orders take 8-11 days. Only 25.5% delivered within fast window (1-3 days).
Business Risk: Competitive vulnerability against next-day delivery industry standards.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Unoptimized carrier routing and absence of regional micro-warehousing.
Action Directive: Renegotiate 3PL contracts establishing 5-day delivery SLAs with tier penalty clauses.
🔵

4. Category Dominance: Electronics Drives 35.8% GMV

Evidence: $1.83M net revenue, 1,777 transactions — primary revenue generator.
Vulnerability: High portfolio dependency on electronics hardware replacement cycles.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Higher product ASP ($257 avg) and consumer demand profile.
Action Directive: Cross-bundle Electronics with high-margin Beauty and Clothing categories.
🟢

5. Payment Method & CSAT Association (χ²=13.96, p=0.007)

Evidence: Card users average 3.02 CSAT ($1,042 AOV) vs. Wallet at 2.93 and COD at 2.94.
Business Upside: Card payments demonstrate lowest dispute and highest customer satisfaction.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Wallet API payment failures or refund friction on return transactions.
Action Directive: Partner with payment gateways to offer 2% instant cashback for Credit/Debit card checkouts.
🔵

6. Geographical Primacy: USA Represents 62.7% of Turnover

Evidence: $3.21M revenue from USA; UK ($704K) and Germany ($423K) lag far behind.
Strategic Target: Untapped European and Asia-Pacific markets present organic runway.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Marketing ad spend skewed predominantly to North American channels.
Action Directive: Localize checkout currencies and marketing copy for UK, DACH, and UAE regions.
🟡

7. Margin Erosion: 44% Orders in High Discount Band

Evidence: $2.00M in revenue was discounted 21-35%. Total discounts cost $1.13M.
Margin Pressure: Risk of conditioning shoppers to only convert during deep markdown promotions.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Blanket markdown policies rather than personalized threshold discounts.
Action Directive: Replace flat markdowns with spend-threshold promotions (e.g., "$50 off on $300+").
🟢

8. Steady Baseline Demand: ~$360K–$400K Annual Turnover

Evidence: Stable order volume (365 orders/year, ~1 order daily) across historical trajectory.
Stability: Low seasonal volatility cushions enterprise against cyclical macroeconomic downturns.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Core consumer replenishment baseline across basic goods.
Action Directive: Introduce annual subscription tier (e.g. VIP club) to lock in baseline ARR.
🔵

9. Prime Demographic Cohort: Age 25–34 Leads Spend

Evidence: $1.01M revenue (19.9%) from 193 active shoppers in the 25-34 demographic.
Cohort Value: Highest average order value and willingness to purchase Electronics.
Root Cause Hypothesis: Tech adoption and disposable income lifecycle overlap.
Action Directive: Allocate 40% of social paid acquisition budgets to lifestyle channels targeting 25-34.
🟢

10. Balanced Domestic Geography: Equal 25% Regional Split

Evidence: West 26.3%, North 25.1%, South 24.4%, East 24.2% — uniform across country.
Operational Advantage: Diversified supply chain risk; zero single-region failure points.
Strategic Alignment: Logistics expansion can be scaled symmetrically nationwide.
Action Directive: Maintain 4 regional distribution hubs with standardized inventory stocking quotas.
